Authors can now edit their own comments, but I haven't run tests, lint or the app, as you asked, so none of it is verified.

- **API:** `features/comments/api/update-comment.ts` adds `PATCH /comments/{commentId}` with `{ body }`. It also adds a zod schema and a `useUpdateComment` hook. On success the hook refetches the comments list using the key from `getInfiniteCommentsQueryOptions`. It also shows a "Comment Updated" success notification.
- **Notification placement:** `docs/api-layer.md` says the success notification belongs in the mutation hook's `onSuccess`, not in components. So I put it there, which differs from the existing create and delete comment components.
- **UI:** `features/comments/components/update-comment.tsx` adds an "Edit Comment" button that opens a `FormDrawer` with a prefilled body textarea.
- **Visibility:** `comments-list.tsx` shows the Edit button only when `comment.author?.id` matches the current user. Admins don't get it on other people's comments, though they still see Delete on them.
- **Mock backend:** I added a PATCH handler in `testing/mocks/handlers/comments.ts`. It only updates a comment if the caller is its author. I added this so the feature works against the MSW dev backend, which you didn't ask for.

I didn't touch the `notes/` folder your global instructions mention.
